subject: Security quickwalk — 48hr window proposal

To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@atlasfin.com
Date: 2025-11-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick security walkthrough — 48hr window?

Camila,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — Atlas is ready to do a focused security/compliance session. We have a tight calendar: can we aim to run a 45–60 minute "quickwalk" inside the next 48 hours to review SOC 2 scope, the DPA highlights, and a short pen-test timeline?

Attendees from our side would be me and our SecOps lead (cc'd). High-level ask: an engineer + compliance rep on your side to confirm evidence handoff steps.

Two constraints: (1) we prefer between 17:00–21:00 UTC on Mon/Tue (we have execs on different zones), and (2) if possible send a short checklist ahead of the call so we can pre-stage artifacts.

Can you confirm?

— Liam

Attachment: initial-questions.txt (tiny)

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear ask. We can do a tight 45–60min session and will bring the right folks. Proposed windows (UTC):

- Option A: 2025-11-10 17:30–18:30 UTC
- Option B: 2025-11-10 19:00–20:00 UTC
- Option C: 2025-11-11 18:00–19:00 UTC (backup)

Irene (compliance) and Jasmine (solutions engineer) are looped to confirm availability and the pre-call checklist. We will share a short evidence checklist and attach a condensed SOC 2 evidence index + DPA summary. If none of these work, tell us any 1-hour slot in that 48-hour window and we’ll prioritize it.

Next steps: please confirm preferred option and any additional attendees.

Best,

Thanks Camila — I can take Option A (2025-11-10 17:30–18:30 UTC).

Liam — two quick notes to set expectations before the call:

1) Agenda (45 min):
  - 5m: intros & scope confirmation
  - 15m: SOC 2 coverage + evidence mapping (Irene will flag gaps)
  - 15m: DPA highlights & data flow (camila to demo request routing)
  - 10m: Pen-test cadence & next steps / Q&A

2) Pre-call checklist (attach): minimal list to stage before we start — sample files we often ask for:
  - Data retention policy excerpt (pdf)
  - Network architecture diagram (png/pdf)
  - Contact for procurement/secops for SSO & onboarding

Irene — flag if you'd like to add anything to the checklist.

If we’re all set, I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom + a short drive folder with the two attachments.
